title: Frontier Gateway Museum

services.name: Indoor Exhibits
services.desc: A large collection of period wagons, farming tools, wagons, and antique firetrucks. Each one tells a story of the rugged landscape and how simplicity and perseverance helped build what you see today! Our vast outdoor exhibits are great to take kids for a more interactive and in-situ feel. First used in 1910, the Golden Valley School was located 16 miles northwest of Glendive and 1/2 miles off the Bloomfield Road. It now resides on our property and contains several period items and some of the original furniture. Take a peek at what it might have been like on the cold prairie, Then take a moment to think on that time grand dad mentioned walking uphill both ways. You may grow an appreciation
